About me

Hi, I'm Louis Wong (he/him), a marketing editor and multimedia storyteller based in Toronto. Since 2020 I have worked as the travelling marketing editor for GLO Travel, preparing seminars and writing feature articles and travel concepts for destinations around the world.

Alongside that, I founded Flowers and Bayonet, an independent media platform, and grew it into a multi-platform audience through articles, interviews and short-form video. I also edit daily video for a YouTube channel with over one million subscribers, so I know what holds attention in the first three seconds.

I speak English, Cantonese and Mandarin fluently, which lets me create content for Chinese-speaking and international travellers alike. I am currently completing a Graduate Certificate in Front-End Web Development at George Brown College (expected 2026).
